title: fix(trust-center): open the real privacy policy, link the consumer health policy, accurate disclosures
body:
**Tier:** T4 (re-graded in fix round 3, OR-112-15: the screen now sends link-failure diagnostics to Sentry, which fires this PR's own promotion trigger "any change that sends data from this screen"; the payload is a closed set of non-personal fields, see the boundary proof below). Was T3: in-app privacy disclosures and policy links for App Store submission and Washington RCW 19.373.
**Why:** Store-package review P0 "Privacy text materially incomplete/inaccurate" and worksheet gap HP15: the Trust & Privacy screen opened `helpUrl('/privacy')`, which resolves to `https://app.trygrowthproject.com/help/privacy` (not the policy); it had no link to a Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy (RCW 19.373.010 counts in-app settings links as part of the app's homepage); and it said "Data residency: US East", "Servers located in US East", "We do not transfer data outside the US without your consent", "Your assigned coach — only what you log (meals + workouts)" and "No one else — we do not sell, share, or license your data". The backend runs on Fly.io `sjc` (US West), other region facts are not verifiable in code, the coach sees much more than meals and workouts, and Anthropic and other providers do receive data.
**T4 trigger scan:** fix round 3: PII boundary (new Sentry report on a failed footer link, through the new `captureErrorWithoutPii`, which drops the signed-in user id and email, request data and breadcrumbs). No auth, payments, deletion, AI calls, data uploads or CI gate files change.
**T3 trigger scan:** user-facing privacy copy (owner/counsel sign-off); cross-repo contract with backend PR BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend#611, which serves `/privacy` (rewritten) and `/consumer-health-privacy` (new). The URLs here must match the backend's `PRIVACY_POLICY_PATH` / `CONSUMER_HEALTH_POLICY_PATH`. Ship with or after #611 (before it deploys, `/consumer-health-privacy` returns 404).
**Bounded T1:** `src/screens/client/README.md` Trust Center section.
**Builder/owner:** Claude Opus 5.5 (T3 builder, policies slice). Owner: operator. Needs one independent audit plus green CI. Not self-audited, not merged.
**Acceptance evidence:** targeted jest below; CI on the head SHA is authoritative. Fix round 3 boundary proof: `trustCenterPolicyLinks.test.tsx` asserts the exact Sentry extras (`toEqual`) and that no query string, fragment or email reaches the report; `sentry.withoutPii.test.ts` asserts the scope processor drops `user`, `request` and `breadcrumbs`. Device check owed in the Friday pass: Settings > Trust & Privacy, tap each of the three links; each opens Safari on the right page (the AASA only claims `/join/*` and `/invite/*`, so these URLs do not loop back into the app).
**Promotion triggers:** any change that sends data from this screen; any new claim about data location, encryption or certifications; changing the policy paths without the backend.

---

## Changes

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `src/config/env.ts` | New `PUBLIC_SITE_BASE_URL` (`https://app.trygrowthproject.com`), `PRIVACY_POLICY_URL` (`/privacy`), `CONSUMER_HEALTH_POLICY_URL` (`/consumer-health-privacy`), `TERMS_URL` (`/terms`). Comment explains why `helpUrl()` must not be used for policies. `helpUrl` unchanged. |
| `src/screens/trustCenterLinks.ts` (new) | The footer link list: Privacy Policy, Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy, Visit the help centre (`helpUrl()` = help index). |
| `src/screens/TrustCenterScreen.tsx` | Footer renders the three links (testIDs `trust-link-privacy`, `trust-link-consumer-health`, `trust-link-help`; failure alert per link). Removed the "Data residency: US East" row and the three "Where your data lives" bullets. Info row: "Your answers and logs are shared with your coach. Your Roman conversations stay private from your coach." Bullets: coach sees consultation answers, logs, check-ins and connected health data; Roman conversations not visible to the coach and kept until the client deletes them or the account (OR-110-1); providers such as Anthropic process data only as the Privacy Policy describes; no sale, no health-data advertising. The `TrustMeta` type and the offline fallback object still carry `dataResidency` (API contract with `/system/trust-meta`); it is no longer displayed. |

## Consultation agreement screen

The single "I agree" consultation screen (P0) is not on `main`; it lives in open mobile PR #310 (`src/screens/consultation/QuestionScreen.tsx`, consent copy version `consult-consent-v1` bound to backend `client-ai-v2` / `pt-waiver-v1`). There is no link slot on `main`, so nothing was changed there, and I did not edit another builder's branch. `CONSUMER_HEALTH_POLICY_URL` is exported so #310 can add a link (for example a `TextLink` under the box) without changing the agreement copy or its version. Follow-up for the #310 owner.

## Needs owner/counsel confirmation (claims I could not verify in code)

1. "Your Roman conversations ... kept until you delete them or your account" and "private from your coach": client delete and account erasure come from backend #601/#608 (no coach route). True only once those are merged and deployed.
2. "Your coach — your consultation answers, logs, check-ins and connected health data": consultation visibility comes with backend #607; connected health data depends on the wearables ingest flag (`FEATURE_WEARABLES_INGEST_POST`, default off) and the open HealthKit `userId` vs strict-DTO fix.
3. "Service providers that run the app for The Growth Project, such as Anthropic ..., only as described in the Privacy Policy" and "Your data is never sold, and your health data is never used for advertising": company commitments. Processor contracts and PostHog/Sentry payload redaction were not verified.
4. Kept as is and not re-verified: "TLS 1.3", "AES-256 at rest", "Keychain / Keystore", and "Receive all your data within 24 hours" on the export row.
5. The `/system/trust-meta` endpoint may still return `dataResidency: 'US East'`; it is no longer shown, but the backend value should be corrected or removed.
6. The consent copy (`client-ai-v2`) says the client can withdraw "in Settings". I found no withdraw control in the mobile app (main or open PRs). The server endpoint exists in #601. A Settings control is needed to match the copy.

## Tests run (local, sandbox; deps linked from the shared install; via heavy.sh)

```
npx jest src/screens/__tests__/trustCenterPolicyLinks.test.tsx --maxWorkers=1 --ci
Tests: 8 passed, 8 total
npx jest src/config/__tests__/helpUrl.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --ci   (with the above: 12 passed)
npx eslint --max-warnings=0 <4 changed ts/tsx files>   clean
npx tsc --noEmit   clean
```
New test cases: policy URLs at the site root and not `/help/`; `helpUrl('/privacy')` is not the policy; consumer health and terms URLs; link list order, labels and https; source no longer calls `helpUrl('/privacy')`; old residency and coach-scope claims gone; render shows all three links and each tap opens the right URL; Roman line shown, no residency row; failed open shows an alert.



## Fix round
| Finding / input | What changed | Commit | Test that proves it |

| owner-approved copy 10-01 09:07 + operator ruling (labels "Privacy", "Delete account") | Trust & Privacy: delete action label, accessibility label and confirm title "Delete my account"/"Delete My Account" -> "Delete account"; export confirmation "Open Data & Privacy in Settings" -> "Open Privacy in Settings" (identical wording and line to #310, so the two merge cleanly). These match the paths the approved policies cite (Settings > Privacy; Settings > Account > Delete account; Trust & Privacy > Request data export). `src/config/env.ts` untouched: its policy-URL block is byte-identical to #310 (`00cfb6c3`), same blob `39fdf30`. | d9c2e66c | `trustCenterPolicyLinks.test.tsx`: "uses the approved Settings labels"; "keeps the policy paths the backend serves" (`/privacy`, `/consumer-health-privacy`); existing render test taps each link and asserts `Linking.openURL` with `https://app.trygrowthproject.com/privacy` and `/consumer-health-privacy` |

Tier re-check for this round: copy-only; no promotion trigger fired; tier unchanged (T3).
Status updates to the sections above: P0 consent now lives in #310 with the D2 two boxes (`consult-consent-v2` / `client-ai-v3`) and a Privacy Policy link per operator ruling; the withdraw control (item 6) exists in #310 as Settings > Privacy > Roman and AI.
URLs verified: `https://app.trygrowthproject.com/privacy` (served by #611 `@Get('privacy')`; live 200 today with the pre-#611 text) and `https://app.trygrowthproject.com/consumer-health-privacy` (served by #611 `@Get('consumer-health-privacy')`; live 404 until #611 deploys). Ship with or after #611 is deployed.
Merge note: #310 also edits `TrustCenterScreen.tsx` imports next to the line this PR replaces (`import { helpUrl } ...`); expect a small textual conflict in the import block whichever merges second (pre-existing, not from this round).

Tests run this round (heavy.sh, `--runInBand --ci`): `npx jest src/screens/__tests__/trustCenterPolicyLinks.test.tsx` -> 10 passed. eslint clean; `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` clean.

### Fix round 2 (lane B-CONSENT-4, agent 112): merge main 2c17c241 (#310 merged) and the Roman retention line

Head `de1c79aa5904ae9600181587cd163e1259e43882`. Two commits: merge `3260719` and fix `de1c79a`.

| Item | What changed | Commit | Test that proves it |
|---|---|---|---|
| Merge main (conflict in `TrustCenterScreen.tsx` + its test) | Kept from main (#310 and earlier): the Delete account row navigates to the `DeleteAccount` screen (no in-place `deletionApi.requestDeletion`); subtitle "A grace period to change your mind before permanent deletion"; help-link failure uses `HELP_UNAVAILABLE_COPY`. Kept from #315: the "Delete account" label, the `trustCenterLinks` policy footer and its failure copy. | 3260719 | `trustCenterPolicyLinks.test.tsx`: Delete account calls `navigation.navigate('DeleteAccount')` and never `deletionApi.requestDeletion`; help-link failure test |
| Owner OR-110-1 Roman retention (no fixed-period purge) | The Roman bullet now reads "Not your coach — your Roman conversations, which are kept until you delete them or your account" (matches #611 and backend #635); the earlier fixed-period wording is gone. | de1c79a | `trustCenterPolicyLinks.test.tsx`: new line present, no fixed retention period anywhere on the screen. The test fails with the old line (negative run). |

Tests (heavy.sh, `--runInBand`): `npx jest --runInBand src/screens/__tests__/trustCenterPolicyLinks.test.tsx`: 12/12 PASS; eslint 0. CI at de1c79a: Typecheck, lint, test; Analyze (actions); Analyze (javascript-typescript); CodeQL, all pass; MERGEABLE. The earlier dual APPROVE (d9c2e669) predates this merge, so both delta audits are needed at this head.

Open risk (unchanged, approved copy): the policy-link failure says "Could not open this page right now. Please try again later." That gives no specific next step. A follow-up could name the URL or point to support. **Closed in fix round 3 (OR-112-15), below.**

### Fix round 3 (lane B-315-ERR, agent 112): OR-112-15 policy-link failure copy

Head `d545f5b63bf65071ca3fb25d0a6921c93273099d`. Three commits: merge `75a177f` (main `f34b5b99`, #324 `SupportEmailFallback` + `SUPPORT_EMAIL`; clean, no conflicts), fix `216ec1f`, fix `d545f5b`.

| Finding / input | What changed | Commit | Test that proves it |
|---|---|---|---|
| OR-112-15 policy-link failure copy (owner rule: no generic error messages, ever) | The footer links no longer alert "Could not open this page right now. Please try again later." New `src/screens/trustCenterLinkFailure.ts`: `openTrustCenterLink` never rejects and returns the cause. **Offline** (NetInfo `isConnected === false` before opening, or unreachable after `openURL` rejects): "This phone is offline, so the Privacy Policy did not open. Connect to Wi-Fi or mobile data, then tap the link again." **Cannot open links** (`canOpenURL` false or `openURL` rejects): "This phone could not open the Privacy Policy in a web browser. Open any browser, on this phone or another device, and go to the address below." plus the exact address as selectable text and Copy web address. **Anything else** (e.g. `canOpenURL` rejects): "The Privacy Policy did not open on this phone. Open any browser and go to the address below. If it still does not open, email Bradleyapple1031@gmail.com and mention reference 1a2b3c4d." plus the address, Copy web address, Email support (`useSupportEmail`, subject carries the reference) and the shared `SupportEmailFallback` when no email app opens. Each message names its page (Privacy Policy / Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy / help centre). The notice shows under the link that failed (live region; announced on iOS; scrolled into view). The help centre link uses the same handling (it was "The help centre did not open on this phone ..." for every cause). A NetInfo "reachable: false" alone never blocks a tap (the probe can be wrong; the browser shows its own offline page). | 216ec1f | `trustCenterPolicyLinks.test.tsx`: offline (no open attempted, nothing reported, reconnect + tap opens), help-centre offline, reachability-alone does not block, open rejected while unreachable -> offline, `canOpenURL` false -> address + copy, `openURL` rejects -> address, copy failure, `canOpenURL` rejects -> email + reference matching the report + Email support draft, no email app -> shared fallback, copy rules for every link x cause (names the page; no "try again later", no first person, no "!"), no unhandled rejection |
| Sentry without PII | Every non-offline failure is reported with only `where`, `link` id, `cause`, `step`, `reference`, the address without query string or fragment, and the error name/message scrubbed by `sentrySafeText` (no emails, no query strings). `setSentryUser` tags all events app-wide with the user's id and email, so the report goes through new `captureErrorWithoutPii` (`services/sentry.ts`): a scope event processor `stripPersonalData` drops `user`, `request` and `breadcrumbs`; scope processors run after the SDK's own (incl. the RN device-context processor that copies the native user). | 216ec1f, d545f5b | `trustCenterPolicyLinks.test.tsx`: exact extras (`toEqual`), a rejection carrying `?token=...#frag` and an email reaches Sentry as `... /privacy' for [email] ...`, the plain `captureError` is never used for link failures; `sentry.withoutPii.test.ts`: no-op before init, extras set, processor drops user/request/breadcrumbs and keeps the rest |
| Docs | `src/screens/client/README.md` Trust Center section: failure handling; also the stale fixed-period retention line (OR-110-1). `src/services/README.md`: `captureErrorWithoutPii`. | 216ec1f, d545f5b | n/a |

Tier re-check for this round: the promotion trigger "any change that sends data from this screen" fired (Sentry diagnostics), so the tier is re-graded T3 -> T4 (PII boundary). Two independent delta audits are needed at this head (they were already owed after fix round 2).

Tests (heavy.sh, `--runInBand --ci`): `npx jest src/screens/__tests__/trustCenterPolicyLinks.test.tsx src/services/__tests__/sentry.withoutPii.test.ts src/constants/__tests__/supportEmail.guard.test.ts src/screens/settings/__tests__/deletionErrors.test.ts` -> 4 suites, 47 passed. Negative run: the same two test files on `de1c79aa` -> 16 failed, 11 passed (the 11 are the pre-existing URL, label, disclosure and open-each-link cases and the reachability-alone regression guard). eslint `--max-warnings=0` on the 7 changed ts/tsx files: clean. `npm run guard:vendors`, `check-expected-env`, `validate:config`: pass. tsc and the full suite run in CI (`216ec1f`: Typecheck, lint, test passed).

Device check owed in the Friday pass (added): airplane mode, tap Privacy Policy -> offline notice under the link; back online, tap -> Safari opens the policy. VoiceOver reads the notice.

Known, not changed (shared #324 copy): when no email app opens, `SupportEmailFallback` says "... write to us from any email app or device." (first person). That component is shared app-wide and owned by #324; changing it is outside this PR.

### Fix round 4 (lane S-B2, sub-manager 114-S, builder Claude Opus 5.5; not a self-audit) → head `0ef94ddf4bbcab54ef29a36be10a6a2e0ad256aa`

Answers Sol RC 5963343453 (B-315-1) at `d545f5b6`, plus operator 19:05 rulings and the pre-push checklist. Commits:
- merge `0d4cfe07` (main `aae30ac0`, #330 Sentry native init). Not pure: one conflict, in `src/services/sentry.ts`. The resolution keeps this PR's `stripPersonalData` + `captureErrorWithoutPii` and main's id-only `setSentryUser`. The doc comment now says "account id". The resolved tree differs from merge-tree's conflicted output only in that file.
- fix `a78e614b`.
- merge `04470064` (main `1f8981dd`, #314). Pure: merge-tree `8c7ab674` equals the head tree.
- fix `0ef94ddf`.

Tier unchanged: T4.

| Finding / input | What changed | Commit | Test that proves it |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sol B-315-1: native exception name/message reached Sentry extras | `sentrySafeText`, `addressWithoutQuery` and the error fields are removed. A report is the closed allowlist `LinkFailureReport`: `event` (`trust_center.link_open_failed`), `link`, `operation`, `cause`, `error_class` (an enum decided by `instanceof` only, never by reading text), `platform`, `reference`. The exception is a fixed synthetic `TrustCenterLinkError` whose message holds only the link and operation enums. A reference is generated for every non-offline cause. | a78e614b | new real-SDK canary `trustCenterLinkFailure.canary.test.ts`: the real `@sentry/react-native` with the app's `initSentry`, and only RNSentry as a double. A synthetic name, phone, email, identifier, health text and URL path in `canOpenURL`/`openURL` rejections never appear in any envelope. Positive control: every failure was reported. Extras are exactly the allowlist. `trustCenterPolicyLinks.test.tsx`: exact `toEqual` extras per cause |
| OR-112-15 copy rules (no we/us, no "!", a specific next action) | Shared `SupportEmailFallback`: "write to us" became "email support". The transparency bullets became "Service providers that run the app for The Growth Project, ..." and "Your data is never sold, and your health data is never used for advertising". | a78e614b, 0ef94ddf | `SupportEmailFallback.test.tsx` (no we/us), `SupportInboxUnavailable.test.tsx`, `trustCenterPolicyLinks.test.tsx` "checklist (d)" bullets guard |
| Operator 19:05: no fixed retention period anywhere in #315 | The test no longer spells out the retired period; it builds the pattern from numbers. The body is rewritten. The screen keeps "kept until you delete them or your account". | 0ef94ddf | `trustCenterPolicyLinks.test.tsx` retention case (asserts the kept-until line and no fixed period) |
| Checklist (b): a copy result landing after the notice unmounted | `LinkFailureNotice` gets a mount fence around `setCopyState`. The screen's link handler was already fenced by `mounted`. | 0ef94ddf | not observable in React 18 (no warning, no visible state); covered by reading |

Tests (heavy.sh, `env CI=true npx jest --runInBand --forceExit --runTestsByPath`):
- **Before:** fix sources reverted to the merge `0d4cfe07` with the new tests kept: trustCenterPolicyLinks, canary and SupportEmailFallback give 9 failed / 23 passed. The canary shows the synthetic name in the envelope. The bullets guard fails on `a78e614b` (1 failed).
- **After:** 9 suites / 74 passed: trustCenterPolicyLinks, canary, SupportEmailFallback, SupportInboxUnavailable, sentry.withoutPii, sentry.payload, sentry.privacy, sentryPrivacy, supportEmail.guard.
- eslint `--max-warnings=0` clean on all changed ts/tsx files. No package change of its own; main's expo-audio comes in through the merge.

Outside this PR: main's `src/lib/consultation/consentVersion.ts` comment names the retired period (history of v3). It is not in this diff.
